_comment: Tests that fail because of a KNOWN argus bug with an open upstream issue.
A listed test still runs, still reports FAIL, and still counts on the board
-- in the risk index and the pass rate -- because the bug is real. What
changes is the CHECK: its job does not fail the workflow run, so the run is
green when everything matches what is known, and red only when something
a test fails that is NOT listed here   -> red (a new failure);
a test listed here PASSES              -> red (argus fixed it: remove the
entry, or the list goes stale).
Only list a test whose failure is argus's, with the issue that tracks it. A
test that is wrong is fixed, not listed.
Wiring: the dispatch matrices (remote, discover, combination, edge,
workflows) and the runtime-environment jobs read this list. A test elsewhere
needs its job given the same continue-on-error expression before listing it
will keep the run green; until then its job still fails the run, which is

expected.why: scan container ignores --platform when the image is already in the local daemon, and scans the cached architecture without saying so
remote container scans skip ADR-038's platform detection, so a public arm64-only image fails from an amd64 runner
